world.name: Natural Earth 1:10m Cultural Vectors
world.credit: Made with Natural Earth. Free vector and raster map data @ naturalearthdata.com.
world.notes: Public domain (naturalearthdata.com/about/terms-of-use). Borders are de facto; per-country ADM0_A3_XX and FCLASS_XX columns describe other worldviews and are kept for the worldview setting; the disputed-areas file (99 polygons with every view's ADM0_A3_XX) is the world pack's worldviews layer. Text fields are NUL-padded.

usa.name: US Census Bureau cartographic boundaries, gazetteer, population estimates and metro delineations
usa.notes: Works of the US federal government are not subject to copyright (17 U.S.C. 105). Boundaries are the 2025 cartographic boundary files at 1:500,000 (generalised from TIGER/Line and clipped to the shoreline, so points in bays and coastal water fall in no county or place); ZIP Code Tabulation Areas exist only in the 2020 vintage, since ZCTAs are defined once per decennial census. ZCTAs approximate USPS ZIP Code delivery areas, which USPS does not publish as areas. Place populations are the Vintage 2025 Population Estimates (SUB-EST2025, July 2025) for incorporated places (and Urban Honolulu CDP, Hawaii having no incorporated places), and the American Community Survey 2020-2024 5-year estimates (table B01003, total population, from the table-based summary file, which needs no API key) for census-designated places and any place SUB-EST lacks; ZCTA populations are ACS too. CBSA and CSA membership is the July 2023 delineation (OMB Bulletin 23-01): list 1 for counties, list 2 for principal cities. Each ZCTA's postal city name is the city ZIP Code Business Patterns 2023 (County Business Patterns program) gives its ZIP Code, matched to a census place by name within the state, preferring places the 2020 ZCTA-to-place relationship file says overlap the ZCTA; ZIP Codes Business Patterns lacks are named from the other US postal source in postal.json. The files are NAD83 (EPSG:4269), used as WGS84: the two differ by 1-2 m in the US, within the generalisation of these files.

can.name: Statistics Canada, 2021 Census Boundary Files (cartographic)
can.credit: Adapted from Statistics Canada, 2021 Census Boundary Files (cartographic), reference date January 1, 2021. This does not constitute an endorsement by Statistics Canada of this product.
can.notes: Statistics Canada Open Licence (statcan.gc.ca/en/terms-conditions/open-licence); the credit is the licence's required notice for value-added products (the pack reprojects and simplifies the boundaries). Catalogue 92-160-X, reference guide 92-160-G. Cartographic files: clipped to the shoreline (coastal water belongs to no area) but not generalised, with a vertex every few metres; the build simplifies them (Douglas-Peucker, 10 m, per feature). Published only in Statistics Canada Lambert (EPSG:3347, NAD83); the build unprojects to longitude/latitude and uses NAD83 as WGS84 (1-2 m apart in Canada). The zips (Shapefile) sit on www12.statcan.gc.ca, which answers scripted downloads with a browser check (HTTP 403); 'service' is StatCan's own ArcGIS REST service of the same 2021 cartographic files (layers lpr_000b21s_e etc.), which the build can read instead (--via service). Names are StatCan's official forms, some bilingual ('Greater Sudbury / Grand Sudbury'). The Open Government Portal lists the same files under the Open Government Licence - Canada.

ind.name: Local Government Directory (LGD), Ministry of Panchayati Raj
ind.credit: Ministry of Panchayati Raj, Government of India. Local Government Directory (lgdirectory.gov.in), as published on the Open Government Data (OGD) Platform India (data.gov.in), under the Government Open Data Licence - India (GODL), https://www.data.gov.in/Godl
ind.notes: LGD's daily reports of states, districts, sub-districts, urban local bodies (ULBs) and the village and ULB to PIN code tables, the same reports data.gov.in carries under GODL (every data.gov.in page: 'licensed under the Government Open Data License - India'). data.gov.in blocks scripted downloads, so the build reads a community mirror's monthly 7z archives of the daily CSVs (github.com/ramSeraph/opendata, release lgd-archive-extra1; one CSV per day, the newest day is read); the mirror adds nothing to the reports. Codes are LGD's (lgd:state:<code>, lgd:district:<code>, lgd:ulb:<code>). LGD's PIN tables are noisy (a PIN code listed for every ULB of a state is an office address, not membership), so the India pack's states, districts and cities are postal approximations: unions of the PIN areas LGD's tables put in each unit (packbuild/README.md, India pack).

ind.name: All India Pincode Boundary (Department of Posts, Open Government Data Platform India)
ind.credit: Department of Posts, Ministry of Communications, Government of India. All India Pincode Boundary Geo JSON, sourced from the Open Government Data (OGD) Platform India (data.gov.in), under the Government Open Data Licence - India (GODL), https://www.data.gov.in/Godl
ind.notes: The derived states, districts and cities are unions of PIN code areas (each area's LGD unit from the crosswalk), drawn unsimplified so they answer exactly as the PIN areas do.

ind.name: All India Pincode Directory (Department of Posts, Open Government Data Platform India)
ind.credit: Department of Posts, Ministry of Communications, Government of India. All India Pincode Directory, sourced from the Open Government Data (OGD) Platform India (data.gov.in), under the Government Open Data Licence - India (GODL), https://www.data.gov.in/Godl
ind.notes: Where LGD lists no village for a PIN code, the directory's district (matched to LGD by name and the curated former names) gives the PIN area's district.

ind.name: placewise curated datasets: names and airports (datasets/names, datasets/airports)
ind.notes: Curated by the placewise project and licensed CC BY 4.0 (datasets/LICENSE.md in the placewise-data repository): per LGD code, the name placewise shows, former names with the year of the rename and other names in use, each citing the notification or a page citing it; cities LGD's PIN table doesn't draw (Bengaluru as the former BBMP area, Delhi's reunified corporation); words that make a post-office name an institution.

ind.name: Natural Earth 1:10m Cultural Vectors
ind.credit: Made with Natural Earth. Free vector and raster map data @ naturalearthdata.com.
ind.notes: The de facto country polygons the India pack cuts PIN areas along: PIN areas follow India's official boundary, and the parts on ground a neighbour administers (Gilgit-Baltistan, the part of Kashmir Pakistan administers, Aksai Chin, the Shaksgam valley, and border slivers) are flagged india_view_only. Siachen Glacier, which Natural Earth gives to nobody, is not cut (placewise answers it as India de facto).
